disclosure: Full source is frozen locally and identified by this pre-run SHA. Remote executable bytes may be uploaded after results; not valid to claim full GitHub source was committed before execution. Entire source and raw results must be contained in ZIP.
dataset_description: QuixBugs human-crafted Quixey Challenge bugs, externally authored toy algorithmic tasks; NOT observed production software defects and NOT scientific production bug reports.
selection: 20 preselected by literal name in list, chosen for local execution and varied algorithm classes, NOT random sample of 40. Handcrafted input candidates inspect known algorithm contracts and may be bug-aware; no blind claim.
test_design: All methods have six executions of defective program per seed. Sanity: 6 well-formedness checks, metamorphic: 3 base/follow-up pairs, differential reference: 6 queries on fixed reference in addition to 6 defective calls. Strong oracle has MUCH more information; no informational parity, only defective execution parity.
primary_estimand: Within benchmark, count 20 distinct defects detected by ANY of 3 exploratory seeds by each strategy (not independent population generalization). Binary per case, plus per-seed detection, false positives on repaired source.

hypotheses.H1: Metamorphic catches more buggy programs than shallow sanity with same defective-function evaluation budget and zero FP on reference.
hypotheses.H2: Differential reference dominates or ties both without implying cost-fairness (reference access required).
hypotheses.H0: No advantage over sanity, or metamorphic false positives destroy usefulness.
Hother: Input set selected with bug-specific knowledge
Correct variants are benchmark reference but could be imperfect
Time limits cause apparent detection that might also occur on valid expensive tasks

adversarial: False-positive rate on fixed correct versions with same inputs
Status exceptions/StepLimit tracked, not assumed semantic errors
Reference program queries not budget-matched informationally
Benchmark described as synthetic challenge, not production incident
Bug signature selection known before detector design => overfitting/contamination
Simple sanity may not detect semantic failures
grading: 1/3 only if distinct from prior synthetic-mutation findings and source evidence improves epistemic position; 2/3 requires original method + strong matched-information baseline + independent real production failures.
